subject.title: [Bug]: When openclaw sends a link with an underscore to Feishu, the full hyperlink cannot be displayed

question: Should maintainers authorize a new focused OpenClaw Feishu fix PR, or ask one of the existing fork candidates to be refreshed with conflict resolution and live proof?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and aligned with the Feishu plugin boundary, but ClawSweeper should not open a new fix PR while this issue is labeled no-new-fix-pr and all same-repository candidates are already closed.

options.title: Authorize a new focused fix
options.body: Allow a small OpenClaw PR that adds a plugin-local URL-boundary helper, focused tests, and live/redacted Feishu proof before merge.

options.title: Adopt an existing fork candidate
options.body: Ask a fork author to rebase, fix conflicts, address prior review concerns, and provide real Feishu proof before this issue is closed.

options.title: Keep waiting for maintainer direction
options.body: Leave the issue open with no new ClawSweeper fix lane until a Feishu owner chooses the preferred fix shape.

recommendation.title: Authorize a new focused fix
recommendation.body: Allow a small OpenClaw PR that adds a plugin-local URL-boundary helper, focused tests, and live/redacted Feishu proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main Feishu send-path commits make vincentkoc the best available routing owner for the builder and test surface.
